title: feat(nm2frm2lxf): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e1 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,-e1) on the three-axis 'far-face' seed. The added pair at (0,0,-1)/(0,1,-1) removes -e3 from the origin's outgoing set, so the origin has M={+e1}, O={-e2}, cover fails and split fails; the origin is dead for every -e3 path on this seed.
